items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), What Is Behind The Latest Attention?
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) has put wind risk on the menu. The company plans to launch 15 cash-settled wind futures on December 14, 2026, pending regulatory clearance, tied to ENWEX wind power indices. Recent trading suggests investors have been rewarding this kind of product expansion. items.title: What Is Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Betting On With New European Wind Futures?
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) has introduced wind futures contracts tied to major European power markets, expanding its renewable energy derivatives offering. The new products reference wind generation indices across regions that together represent more than 70% of installed wind capacity in Europe.
